title: Brent 3d overextension fades
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Brent price over-extended (20d z-score of BZ=F close > 1) fades: Brent log return reverses over the next 4 days (-); trade short BZ=F 4d [finance.BZ=F.close -> finance.BZ=F.log_return]
message: Not supported: shorting Brent after 20d z>1 over-extension lost money (50 trades, hit 46%, avg -0.30%/trade, Sharpe-like -0.68; OOS war 16 trades hit 37.5%). Brent strength shows momentum, not a fade. Original same-indicator tag collapsed to pre/post mode; signal swapped once to BZ=F.close.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.BZ=F.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Reversal control: Brent price over-extension (20d z-score of BZ=F close > 1) is momentum not mean-reversion: Brent log return continues higher over the next 3 days (+); trade long BZ=F 3d [finance.BZ=F.close -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0018)
